claims.claim: Probe accuracy for code correctness is highly sensitive to construction method, prompt framing, and hidden-state location; no single configuration is best across models and benchmarks.
claims.quoted_support: Our results show that no single configuration recovers the direction best. Only the construction method generalises, while the best prompt framing, read-out location, and model change from one benchmark to the other.

breadth.confidence_families: hidden-state linear probe directions (PCA, mean-diff); token probability and verbalised confidence only as cited prior work (Sec I)
breadth.elicitation_formats: prompt framing neutral vs concept (Sec III, Tables II-III)
breadth.benchmarks: HumanEval (164), BigCodeBench, MBPP+ (fit OOD), synthetic mutant pairs
breadth.label_independence: self-generated candidates scored by tests; benchmark tasks split fit/val/test (Sec III-A)
breadth.calibration_metrics: pairwise ranking accuracy % (Tables II-III); no ECE/Brier
breadth.granularity: whole solution, last-token or other positions
breadth.causal_intervention: not present for steering of code correctness (steering mentioned only in related work)

claims.claim: Prior probe configuration (PCA, last token, neutral fit, concept test) reached only 41-63% max accuracy; accuracy varied by data subset.
claims.quoted_support: However, the highest obtained accuracy ranged from 41–63% across models and benchmarks, suggesting that the method of capturing the representation may not generalize well.

claims.claim: Last-token read-out scores 63-69% when test framing is concept but 37-55% under neutral framing (Table II, BigCodeBench).
claims.quoted_support: the last token scores 63 – 69% across the four models when the testing framing is also concept, but 37 – 55% under a neutral one ( Table II ).

claims.claim: Controlling program pairs to isolate the bug-causing change does not improve the direction; a direction fit on mutant pairs separates them in isolation but does not transfer to ranking real candidates.
claims.quoted_support: Controlling the fitting pairs to isolate the bug-causing change does not improve the direction either — on BigCodeBench a direction fit on such pairs separates them with high accuracy in isolation, yet does not transfer to ranking the benchmark’s own candidate implementations.

claims.quoted_support: recent work captured an internal signal of code correctness that is able to judge candidate solutions better than the model’s token-level or stated confidence, with no test execution.
